componentPackage.provenanceDistinction: extraction.inferredPixelCount describes inferred pixels inside a sprite. repair.inferred describes its own removal backing; false does not imply the sprite contains zero inference.
componentPackage.geometryScope: Visible-only cutouts at authored placements; no complete unseen surfaces for freely moved or rotated objects. Contact detail belongs to its original ground location.
componentPackage.fixedLayerScope: Broad fixed/effect partitions are inspection/depth assets. Hiding fixed structure may expose diagnostic transparent voids, not traversable ground.
componentPackage.footprintScope: One provisional anchor cell per component; not a physics footprint or complete visibility-owner mapping.
